defs.def: to make sb/yourself believe that sth is true 使确信；使相信；使信服

ex.s: Sure, my friends and I loved to _____46_____ about how bored we were in the middle of nowhere; _____47_____ , as I finish up my junior year of college, I’m convinced that it took _____48_____ our small town to realize how much we actually loved it and what exactly we loved about it.
ex.t: 当然，我和朋友们过去总爱____，抱怨我们在这偏僻地方有多无聊；____，当我大学三年级即将结束时，我确信，正是____我们的小镇，才让我们意识到自己其实有多爱它，以及我们究竟爱它什么。

ex.s: After my undergraduate degree, convinced that writing wasn’t for me, I ____43____ to study teaching.
ex.t: 本科毕业后，我认定写作不适合我，于是____去学习教书。

ex.s: A long, negative review of a hotel, complete with lots of information, tended to convince participants.
ex.t: 一条内容翔实的长篇酒店负面评论往往能取信于参与者。

ex.s: Emotion was also important in convincing readers — or the lack of emotion, at least.
ex.t: 情感表达对于说服读者也很重要——或者说，情感的缺失至少同样重要。

ex.s: “There are so many things in parenting that are good to talk through, but I’m not convinced that food is one of them,” she says.
ex.t: 毫不奇怪，这些新概念激发我们建立新的宇宙模型。

ex.s: The man’s words sounded pretty convincing.
ex.t: 所有营员需自带午餐和零食。

ex.s: That was when I met Mr Dena and told him I had ___39___ in math, yet I would try my hardest He was convinced I could succeed ___40___ the doubts from my classmates.
ex.t: 这位男士和女士都想做什么？

ex.s: “Age is just another bot- her attempting to convince you of the impossible in the world, but actually the world is filled with possibilities,” she once said.
ex.t: "年龄不过是另一个试图让你相信世界上有不可能之事的家伙，但实际上世界充满了可能性，"她曾说。

ex.s: So far no one has convincingly made artificial life.
ex.t: 迄今为止，还没有人令人信服地创造出人工生命。

ex.s: Years of experience in the industry - and failed attempts to use technology - have convinced him that the best way to check cattle is with a man on a horse.
ex.t: 邦兹在近50年前买了第一批牛，他仍然让每个牛仔每天检查300或400头牛，寻找生病的迹象。

ex.s: Dirty shorts and old shoes gave him the ____26____ of a real beggar and his convincing dialect soon won him the ____27____ of the beggars.
ex.t: 脏短裤和旧鞋子给了他____26____真正乞丐的外貌，他那令人信服的方言很快赢得了乞丐们的____27____。

ex.s: He says it’s not easy to convince people that nutria fur is green, but he has no doubt about it.
ex.t: 他说要让人相信海狸鼠皮是环保的并不容易，但他对此深信不疑。

ex.s: Today, on an island in the Pacific, a specific type of shell still serves as currency — and some people there are even hoarding it, just like Bitcoin moguls, convinced that one day, it will make them wealthy beyond imagination.
ex.t: "一条深色贝壳可能换到两罐小金枪鱼，但红色的价值更高，对于红色贝壳，一条可能换到足够养活一个大家庭很长时间的金枪鱼。

defs.def: to persuade sb to do sth 说服，劝说（某人做某事）

ex.s: Thoreau’s writing aimed to convince people that animals and plants had a right to live and prosper, as we do.
ex.t: 梭罗的写作旨在让人们相信，动植物和我们一样有权生存和繁衍。

ex.s: I hope I can convince you to stop by and visit us in New York.
ex.t: 我希望能说服你来纽约看望我们。

ex.s: Yuan was convinced that the answer could be found in the creation of hybrid rice.
ex.t: 袁隆平确信答案可以在杂交水稻的培育中找到。

ex.s: Browning was sure about his love, so he found a way to visit her, and immediately convinced her to become his bride.
ex.t: 勃朗宁对自己的爱情深信不疑，于是他设法去看望她，并立即说服她成为他的新娘。

ex.s: I tried to learn how to play it, but after trying for hours, I was convinced that I could never make a musical sound with this instrument!
ex.t: 我试着学弹它，但试了几个小时后，我确信自己永远无法用这种乐器发出音乐之声！
